verdict.rationale: Better Stack's own pages repeatedly claim a first-party MCP server that brings logs, metrics, traces, web events and errors into existing LLM workflows. They name Claude Code and Claude Desktop as clients, so the core story is delivered. The evidence is marketing-level only: missing for 10: MCP server setup/connection documentation, a list of exposed tools or capabilities, details of how the MCP server authenticates, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
